name: Executive Sales Performance & Revenue Trend Dashboard
description: C-suite executive monitoring dashboard visualizing revenue trajectory, growth rates (MoM/YoY), AOV, and customer buying rhythms on Trino MPP Lakehouse.

cards.name: Total Net Revenue (Gold)
cards.description: Cumulative net revenue after discounts from gold_sale_mart.fact_order

native.query: SELECT CAST(SUM(sub_total) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS net_revenue FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order;

cards.name: Total Completed Orders
cards.description: Distinct count of completed customer orders

native.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS total_orders FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order;

cards.name: Average Order Value (AOV)
cards.description: Average net revenue realized per transaction

native.query: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(sub_total) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT order_id), 0), 2) AS aov FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order;

cards.name: Effective Discount Rate
cards.description: Overall discount percentage applied relative to gross revenue

native.query: SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(discount_amt) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(price), 0) * 100, 2) AS discount_rate_pct FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order;

cards.name: Monthly Net Revenue & MoM Growth Rate
cards.description: Monthly chronological net revenue run rate and percentage month-over-month expansion

native.query: WITH monthly_metrics AS (SELECT d.year, d.month, d.month_year, CAST(SUM(f.sub_total) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS net_revenue FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order f INNER JOIN lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.year, d.month, d.month_year) SELECT month_year, net_revenue, ROUND((CAST(net_revenue AS DOUBLE) - LAG(CAST(net_revenue AS DOUBLE)) OVER (ORDER BY year, month)) / NULLIF(LAG(CAST(net_revenue AS DOUBLE)) OVER (ORDER BY year, month), 0) * 100, 2) AS mom_revenue_growth_pct FROM monthly_metrics ORDER BY year, month;

cards.name: Quarterly Performance & YoY Expansion
cards.description: Quarterly revenue pacing and year-over-year growth benchmarks

native.query: WITH quarterly_metrics AS (SELECT d.year, d.quarter, d.quarter_year, CAST(SUM(f.sub_total) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS net_revenue FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order f INNER JOIN lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.year, d.quarter, d.quarter_year) SELECT quarter_year, net_revenue, ROUND((CAST(net_revenue AS DOUBLE) - LAG(CAST(net_revenue AS DOUBLE), 4) OVER (ORDER BY year, quarter)) / NULLIF(LAG(CAST(net_revenue AS DOUBLE), 4) OVER (ORDER BY year, quarter), 0) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_pct FROM quarterly_metrics ORDER BY year, quarter;

cards.name: Daily Sales Velocity & 7-Day Moving Average
cards.description: Continuous daily sales run-rate overlaid with 7-day smoothing window

native.query: WITH daily_metrics AS (SELECT d.calendar_date, CAST(SUM(f.sub_total) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS daily_net_revenue FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order f INNER JOIN lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.calendar_date) SELECT calendar_date, daily_net_revenue, ROUND(AVG(CAST(daily_net_revenue AS DOUBLE)) OVER (ORDER BY calendar_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 2) AS moving_avg_7d_net_revenue FROM daily_metrics ORDER BY calendar_date ASC;

cards.name: Day-of-Week Customer Shopping Distribution
cards.description: Total revenue and share of sales generated across days of the week

native.query: SELECT d.day_name, CAST(SUM(f.sub_total) AS DECIMAL(18, 2)) AS net_revenue FROM lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.fact_order f INNER JOIN lakehouse.gold_sale_mart.dim_date d ON f.date_key = d.date_key GROUP BY d.day_name, d.day_of_week ORDER BY net_revenue DESC;
